shadows.name: Clarity Layer
shadows.purpose: Creating depth through transparency while maintaining legibility.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action. High contrast Teal on Slate.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3DE4C1; color: #0f172a; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 0.625rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2db3a1; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: A layered container for secondary context. Use with extreme caution.
components.html:
Helpful Insight

AI search favors semantic clarity over keyword density.
components.css: .ds-card-glass { backdrop-filter: blur(24px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 0.625rem; padding: 24px; } .ds-heading { font-weight: 800; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-text { color: #334155; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: A bold, helpful design system for non-profits navigating the AI era. Rejects AI slop in favor of structural clarity.
dos: Do prioritize semantic HTML tags for AI indexing.
donts: Don't use generic AI purples or neon glows.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default (extreme caution).
